name: Zolo Advanced Heading
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
Zolo Advanced Heading is a Gutenberg block plugin designed to create stunning, customizable headings for your WordPress site. It offers advanced features like font customization, text highlighting, and image masking. With this block, you can elevate the visual appeal of your headlines effortlessly.

Key Features:

  • Fully customizable heading block.
  • Advanced typography controls.
  • Text highlighting options for stylish designs.
  • Image masking for unique visual effects.
  • Seamless integration with the Gutenberg editor.
  • Fully responsive and optimized for modern browsers.

Whether you’re creating blog posts, landing pages, or portfolio sites, Zolo Advanced Heading empowers you to craft beautiful and dynamic headlines.

Features

  • Advanced typography and text customization.
  • Highlight specific words or phrases with stylish effects.
  • Add image masks to your headings for a modern design.
  • Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop views.
  • Lightweight and fast, designed to keep your site running smoothly.
sections.installation:
Plugin Installation from the WordPress Dashboard:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Zolo Advanced Heading” in the search bar.
  4. Click the Install Now button.
  5. Once installed, click Activate to enable the plugin.

Manual Installation via Zip File:

  1. Download the Zolo Advanced Heading plugin zip file from WordPress.org.
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Select the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  5. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
sections.faq:
How To Use?

  1. Add the Advanced Heading Block:

    • Open the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).
    • Click the “+” button to add a new block.
    • Search for “Advanced Heading” and select it from the block library.

  2. Customize Your Heading:

    • After adding the block, select it to access the block settings in the right-hand sidebar.
    • Options available for customization include:
      • Font Settings: Choose font size, weight, and style.
      • Color Settings: Adjust text color, background color, and gradient options.
      • Alignment: Set text alignment to left, center, or right.
      • Typography Controls: Fine-tune letter spacing, line height, and font family.
      • HTML Tag: Change the heading level (H1–H6).

  3. Apply Advanced Styles:

    • Add gradients, shadows, or background effects using the provided settings.
    • Use responsive controls to set styles for desktop, tablet, and mobile views.

  4. Save and Preview:

    • Save your changes and preview the post/page to ensure the heading looks as intended.

  5. Custom CSS (Optional):

    • Add a custom CSS class in the block settings for further styling using custom CSS.

What features does the plugin offer?

The plugin offers advanced typography controls, text highlighting, image masking, and seamless integration with the Gutenberg editor.

Does the plugin work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Zolo Advanced Heading is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports the block editor.

Is there a Pro version available?

Yes, upgrading to the Pro version unlocks additional features, advanced styling options, and priority support.

Do I need any page builder like Elementor or Divi to use this plugin?

No, this plugin is built specifically for the Gutenberg editor and eliminates the need for third-party page builders.
